content: githubkit 0.16.1 is a fully-typed, auto-generated GitHub SDK (REST + GraphQL + webhooks) built on httpx, sync+async, optional Pydantic validation of webhook events and responses, pagination, retry, GitHub App auth. PyGithub 2.10.0 is mature/popular but partially typed and REST-only, no webhook parsing. For this project (issues, comments, PRs, and webhook event handling with typed models) githubkit is recommended; PyGithub is the conservative fallback.
